subject: Re: CKD kickoff — hallucination-resistant captioning via contrastive distillation
body:
Status.

Data pipeline: stage 1 (negative-object mining) complete for VG and COCO; GQA lands this week. Stage 2 description caching is at 78% of VG — Chiara's retry logic sorted out the rate-limit stalls. The cache design is paying off, reruns are basically free.

Eval: POPE harness is live. Baseline numbers on our current captioner: 84.6 F1 on the random split but only 71.2 on the adversarial split — that adversarial gap IS the hallucination problem, so it's our primary metric.

Risk/trade-off: pilot distillation on 10% data moves adversarial POPE +2.9 but costs 0.8 CIDEr on caption fluency. Wei thinks the fluency dip shrinks with the full dataset and a lower distillation weight; if it doesn't, we'll need a product call on the trade-off. Flagging now so its not a surprise in July.

Fumiko
